en.title: Count Balanced Nodes (Deloitte OA)
en.description: You are given a tree rooted at node 1. A node is balanced if the subtrees of all its direct children have the same size; leaf nodes are considered balanced as stated in the problem. Output the total number of balanced nodes. This site supplements the parent-list input protocol and the size limits.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤200000); the second line contains n−1 integers, the parent labels of nodes 2..n in order (1-based). When n=1, the second line may be empty. The input is guaranteed to form a tree rooted at node 1.
en.output: Output the number of balanced nodes.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the detailed algorithm, proof, and notes on this site's protocol.
hints: First compute the subtree size of each node.
Compare the subtree sizes of the direct children, not the number of children or the tree heights.
